items.title: 67849_Leroy Elliot Stewart oral history interview
items.q: I had a violin teacher whose name was -- I will never forget his name. His name - We used to call him Professor Scott, and he -- he taught me some good things about the fiddle

ctx.x: When you were -- what kind of a neighborhood did you grow up in?

Well, a small town, Englewood, right across from New York, you might say. I was brought up in a very country, you know, it was real country out there, and the neighborhood kids -- it was a very nice neighborhood, and of course I friends beautiful, had lots of things. And as I was going along in years and studying the violin, I had a violin teacher whose name was -- I will never forget his name.
